tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum gyi mtha' dpyod yig chung bzhugs pa dge'o// rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir nā ro mkha' spyod kyi khrid 'chad skabs gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum zhes pa'i gsung rgyun 'di bzhin la/ /dus phyis go don bkrol nas ljags bshad gnang mkhan ni mjal ma myong zhing / yig cha rang du ni gsal kha dod pa zhig mi 'dug gshis the tshom gyi gnas su gyur pa/ kho bos bsam gzhig byas pa'i go yul du/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i nyams khrid 'chad pa'i dus/ de dang rjes su 'brel bar ston rgyu'i man ngag zhal shes gsum du 'dod de/ gsum gang zhe na/ sngon 'gro thun rkyen tshogs bsog pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa bstan/ de la nang gses kyis bla ma bskyed pa dang / bstims pa'i zhal shes gnyis/ 'jug tu zhal shes gsum pa tshe gcig la mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'i gser chos bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa ste gsum du 'dod/ rgyu mtshan yang / gang zag thun mong bas nyams su blang bya'i rnal 'byor ni rje sa skya pa chen pos bcu gcig tu bsdu bar mdzad cing / de tsam la ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / bsam mi khyab kyang yi ge rnying pa rnams kyi dkyus na yod pa tsam gyi go chod la/ rdzogs rim yang zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis las mi ston pa'i lugs su byas/ gdul bya snod du rung nges la/ shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i rnal 'byor bstan/ de nas rlung sems a wa dhū tir bcug pa la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyisaṃ dang bralaṃ ba'i ye shes khyad par can myur du skye bar 'gyur zhing / thabs lam zab mo de nyid 'chaṃd par 'os pa'i slob ma de la de dang dus mnyam par/ sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang thun mong ma yin pa bskyed bstims byed tshul dang / 'jug bsam mi khyab kyang thun mong ma yin pa bcas gzhan la med pa'i man ngag bla ma'i zhalaṃ las shesaṃ dgos pa gsum po'ang bstan zhes pa'i don yin/

/zhal shes gsum po bla ma bskyed bstims dang / bsam mi khyab gsum du nges dgos pa'i shes byed ni/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtses/ gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum zhes 'byung ba'i zhal shes dang po thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom ste zhes dang / zhal shes gnyis pa bla ma bstims pa'i zhal shes gnyis blangs te zhes dang / mchog tu gyur pa zhal shes gsum pa nang gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa'am/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zhal shes zhes gsungs/ rdo rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyis kyang de kho na bzhin bshad/ gzhan yang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i mthong grol lde mig las maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid du grags pa gnyis bral 'chad dus kyi zhal shes dang po dang gnyis pa'i sems 'dzin gtong zhes dang / zhal shes gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas chig brgyud las/ snod ldan gnyis gsum la ston kyang re re nas ston pa las lhan cig tu ye mi gnang zhes dang / yab rje kun blos sa chen thugs thig tu yang de ji lta bar bshad/ zhi ba lha'i khrid yig tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor la dbang blang ba'i zhal shes dang gsum du snang yang yi ge rnying pa rnams su snga ma kho na bzhin zhal shes gnyis su bsdu bar mdzad 'dug yang rdo brag rig 'dzin chen pos bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs gnyis bral 'chad dus zhes mi brjod par maṇ+ḍal zhes bsgyur kha byas na legs tshul gsungs 'dug kyang / de la rgyu mtshan yod pa ma mthong / yang 'ga' zhig gis rnam bshad dang / sems 'dzin gnyis bral 'chad 'dug pa ni bral zhes pa'i don tsam yang ma dgongs par 'dug 'o na zhal shes gsum po de bzhin gnyis bral kho rang gi nang du tshang dgos pa zhig ma yin nam snyam na de yang ma nges te/ gnyis bral la ni zhal shes gsum zhes yod na de ltar tshang dgos shes che na'ang / 'dir ni gnyis bral 'chad dus zhes bshad pas/

gnyis bral kho rang logs su bkar nas de 'chad dus der ma 'thus pa'i zhal shes gsum zhes bzlo ba'i don du go dgos pa 'dra zhing / ma zad dbu ma rang la zhal shes kyi tha snyad btags mi 'dug pa'i phyir/ 'o na gnyis bral zhes pa dbu ma rang la ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i gtan tshigs ci yod snyam na/ brtag gnyis las/ rkyang ma shes rab rang bzhin te/ /thabs kyi ro ma yang dag gnas/ /kun 'dar ma ni dbus gnas su/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spang / /zhes gsung pa'i don gong du smros pa ltar gnyis bral gyi ye shes ni dbu mar rlung sems tshud pa kho na las skye zhing / de ma tshud na mi skye bas/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming gis btags pa yin cing / gzhan du gnyis bral gyi tha snyad btags su rung ba 'ga' yang ma rnyed pas kho bo ni de kho na nyid 'dod/ 'on kyang mkhas pa gzhan dag gis rnam dpyod kyis bsgrubs te 'di ma yin pa'i ngos 'dzin lung rigs dang 'brel ba gsungs 'os byung na thugs la brtags 'tshal/ spyir mkha' spyod ma 'dir zhal shes kyi yig chung ni gsum du ma zad/ dbang bzhi lus sgrigs/ lus dkyil 'pho ba sogs mchis kyang gnyis bral 'chad dus kyi zhal shes sngar smros pa de dag 'khrul med yin na/ /zhes pa'ang gzim 'og sprul ming byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyis sbyar ba'o/ /zhal gro/ 'di'i lung brgyud ni mdzad pa po mkhas dbang byams pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ byams pa snyan grags mthar pa/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag dam chos lhun grub la'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 gzim 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ zhal shes gsum gyi mtha' dpyod yig chung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
